meta.title: Miller County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Miller County's 2026 budget as adopted by the quorum court on December 22, 2025, and filed with the state. Each office shows two printed totals: salaries and benefits, and operations (supplies, services and equipment). Some funds move money to other county funds, such as County General's $500,000 transfer out and the Crime Case Coordinator fund's $80,000, so those dollars also show up in the funds that receive them.

nodes.name: Jail Maintenance & Operation (0418)
nodes.note: The page labels this amount 'FUND TOTAL', but it is the total for department 0418 only; the fund total ($5,717,703.00, p. 73) also includes department 0425.

nodes.name: Jail Maintenance & Operation (0425)
nodes.note: Overtime, social security and retirement lines are listed in this block's operations column, so they are part of its Operation Total.
